question.text: A sinusoidal voltage of peak value <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>250</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">V</mi></math> is applied to a series <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>L</mi><mi>C</mi><mi>R</mi></math> circuit, in which <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>R</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>8</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">Ω</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>L</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>24</mn><mo> </mo><mi>mH</mi></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>C</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>60</mn><mo> </mo><mi>μ</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">F</mi></math>. The value of power dissipated at resonant condition is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>x</mi></math> <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>kW</mi></math>. The value of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>x</mi></math> to the nearest integer is _______.
